rationale: Both candidates converge on the same device-sync problem in the packed-metadata path and on the unsupported '2%' latency claim, showing solid grounding. X's standout catch is the denoise_loop.py sigma/timestep bug, which precisely matches the ground truth's confirmed 'corrected timestep to use t = 1 - sigma' fix — a genuine blind hit. Y instead misfires there, explicitly (and incorrectly) asserting the sigma convention is fine, a real precision blemish. But Y engages far more substantively with the PR's highest-severity ground-truth concern (the AllGather-KV local-Q/global-KV mismatch), correctly diagnosing the root mechanism (query_ranges not honored) rather than X's shallow 'add a test' framing, and backs its two novel packed-metadata bugs (unvalidated max_seqlen, all-False mask degenerate case) with concrete verified input/output reproductions in the exact code region the ground-truth P1/P2 comments target. Both are highly actionable with file:line specificity and concrete suggested fixes.
